card.name: Stretching or overstating a claim
card.fires_on: Words in idioms and phrases about exaggeration or stretching the truth, such as "stretching the bow too far", "overstatement", "by no stretch", "no exaggeration". It fires on the words inside the phrase, not on drug text.

modes.label: Stretching idiom
modes.description: Words inside the idiom about stretching a bow or the imagination.
modes.example: they may be wrong — they may be stretching<< the>> bow too far.

modes.label: Overstatement wording
modes.description: Words in phrases that say a claim goes too far or is exaggerated.
modes.example: It might be an over<<statement>> to say that Egypt was acquainted with democratic
